in_arabic.name: شريف
in_arabic.meaning: الشريف يعني الشخص ذو الشرف و العزّة و النسب الرفيع
in_arabic.long_meaning: الشريف هو الشخص الذي يتميز بالشرف و العزّة و النسب الرفيع، و هو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن المكانة الرفيعة و الاحترام في المجتمع الإسلامي. وردت كلمة شريف في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ شَعَائِرَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِن تَقْوَى الْقُلُوبِ' (الحج: 32)، و في الحديث النبوي الشريف: 'أَكْرَمُ النَّاسِ ذُو الشَّرَفِ و الأَصلِ'.

in_urdu.name: شریف
in_urdu.meaning: شریف کا مطلب ہے شرف والا، عزت والا، اور اعلیٰ نسب
in_urdu.long_meaning: شریف نام کا مطلب ہے شرف والا، عزت والا، اور اعلیٰ نسب۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں ایک اعلیٰ مقام رکھتا ہے، اور اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی کیا گیا ہے۔ شریف نام کے حامل شخص کو شرف اور عزت حاصل ہوتی ہے، اور یہ نام جنوب ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں بہت مقبول ہے۔

in_hindi.name: शरीफ
in_hindi.meaning: शरीफ का अर्थ है शरफ वाला, इज्जत वाला, और उच्च वंश
in_hindi.long_meaning: शरीफ नाम का अर्थ है शरफ वाला, इज्जत वाला, और उच्च वंश। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है, और इसका उल्लेख इस्लामी परंपरा में एक उच्च स्थान के रूप में किया गया है। शरीफ नाम के धारक व्यक्ति को शरफ और इज्जत प्राप्त होती है।

in_pashto.name: شريف
in_pashto.meaning: شريف د شرف لرونکی، عزت لرونکی، او لوړ نسب معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: شريف نوم د شرف لرونکی، عزت لرونکی، او لوړ نسب معنی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې ډیر مشهور دی، او د اسلامي دودیزو کې یې لوړ مقام دی. شريف نوم لرونکی کس ته شرف او عزت حاصل وي.

in_english.name: Sharif
in_english.meaning: Sharif means noble, honored, and of high lineage
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sharif is derived from the Arabic root 'ش-ر-ف' which means 'to honor' or 'to elevate'. It is an important name in Islamic tradition, symbolizing nobility and high social status. The term 'Sharif' is used to describe descendants of the Prophet Muhammad through his daughter Fatimah. Throughout history, the name Sharif has been associated with leadership, dignity, and respect in various Muslim cultures.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sharif carries a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world, evoking images of nobility, grace, and refinement. It is a name that has been borne by many distinguished and influential figures throughout history in the Middle East and beyond. The name Sharif is often used as a title of respect for dignitaries, scholars, and religious leaders, reflecting their noble character and high status within their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name Sharif represents the ideal of being a noble servant of God. The Arabic root of the name, sh-r-f, means "noble, exalted, and honorable," and is derived from the Arabic word sharafah, which refers to the feeling of respect, awe, or reverence that inspires love and devotion towards the Divine. By carrying the name Sharif, one is reminded of the importance of striving to live a life of nobility and integrity, and of keeping a high moral character as a reflection of one's faith and commitment to God.

historical_references.reference: The Sharifs of Medina were a distinguished Arab family who traced their descent from the Prophet Muhammad through his uncle, Al-Abbas ibn Abdul Muttalib. They were the guardians of the Prophet's tomb and played a significant role in the early Islamic state.
historical_references.context: The Sharifs of Medina were among the most influential figures in early Islamic history and were highly respected for their genealogical connection to the Prophet.

historical_references.reference: The Sharifs of Mecca were the hereditary custodians of the Kaaba, the holiest site in Islam, and were considered the spiritual leaders of the Muslim community. Their influence continued until the Ottoman conquest in the 16th century.
historical_references.context: The Sharifs of Mecca were the spiritual and temporal rulers of the Muslim holy cities, and their authority extended beyond the Arabian Peninsula.
